answer: Anchor every agent identity to a stake-backed kernel: to join, an agent must lock collateral in a shared registry and publish a verifiable work history. A reputation atlas maps each identity to the graph of agents it has transacted with, so a lone vertex with no inbound trust edges earns nothing. Forging thousands of fake identities then costs real collateral per vertex, and the atlas exposes clusters of sock-puppets that only vouch for each other, letting the network quarantine them at near-zero cost to honest agents.
